limitations: Godot 4 and 2D PNG only; no 3D, GLB, Unity, Unreal or GameMaker
No patch generation: no model calls, no API keys, no network
Collision polygons are interpreted in texture-pixel space relative to the sprite origin; not a general transform
One receipt lineage per receipts directory; forking the chain is refused as BROKEN_CHAIN
Whole-atlas consistency only, not frame-by-frame sprite-sheet animation
darwin and linux binaries only; no Windows build
Some Godot fields were mapped without a field-by-field on-disk sample; the README table is the contract
